description: Galactic Memoirs is a single-handed project made by a young coder whom is brilliant in the topic of space. He focuses about things that people think are scrap but sees it as memory and succession such as Viking 2's CHSU. Even then, my main passion is to think of ideas and try learning more and more because I am still young.
summary: I created a project where we discover the pieces of hardware used by NASA on Mars.
details: It works by giving a set of options to choose referring to the main challenge. It gives the knowledge about the old equipment left by NASA on the Mars. The intended impact is to educate the kids about the harsh weather of the Mars and enjoy as well.
